The site Hetzdorf (ICOS code DE-Hzd) has been established at a 40 ha windthrow area caused by the Kyrill storm in 2007 within a large forested area (60 km?) near the city of Tharandt. After the disturbance oaks have been planted. The site is located in the suboceanic/subcontinental climate.
